section_opening_preview:
This section is the analogue of
More on Algebra, Section \ref{more-algebra-section-rank}
for quasi-coherent modules.
Recall that if $X$ is an integral scheme with generic point $\eta$,
then the local ring $\mathcal{O}_{X, \eta}$ is equal to the
residue field $\kappa(\eta)$, see
Morphisms, Lemma \ref{morphisms-lemma-integral-scheme-rational-functions}.

statement_tex:
\label{lemma-dominant-pullback-rank}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a dominant morphism of integral schemes.
Let $\mathcal{G}$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_Y$-module.
Then the rank of $\mathcal{G}$ on $Y$ is equal to the rank
of $f^*\mathcal{G}$ on $X$.

statement_tex:
\label{lemma-rank-tensor}
Let $X$ be an integral scheme. Let
$\mathcal{F}$ and $\mathcal{G}$ be
quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_X$-modules.
\begin{enumerate}
\item The rank of $\mathcal{F} \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X} \mathcal{G}$
is the product of the ranks of $\mathcal{F}$ and $\mathcal{G}$.
\item If $\mathcal{F}$ is of finite presentation, then
the rank of $\SheafHom_{\mathcal{O}_X}(\mathcal{F}, \mathcal{G})$
is the product of the ranks of $\mathcal{F}$ and $\mathcal{G}$.
\end{enumerate}
